prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one continuous non-pixel 2D top-down RPG village ground background, target EXACT 3840x2160 (16:9), fully opaque RGBA. A walkable painting, no UI, no panels.
Match the three preceding GatherPlaces environment images' warm fine ink contours, clear soft cel painting, matte oak timber, slate gray stone, cream plaster, terracotta roofs, medieval fantasy village. They are STYLE references only, NOT their frontal viewpoint or dark foreground. Bright open daytime sun from upper left, restrained soft shadows, clean color, no noise.
CAMERA: high oblique bird's-eye view about 55 degrees downward, orthographic/near parallel projection. NO horizon, NO sky, NO distant landscape. Ground plane fills the entire rectangular image. Tops of roofs visible with a modest amount of south-facing front facades. The viewer can walk over most of the image.
SCALE: final world map 3840x2160, viewed through a scrolling 1920x1080 camera. An adult avatar would be 135 pixels tall IN THE FULL 3840x2160 IMAGE, i.e. 1/8 of the 1080px camera viewport; do not draw avatar. Door openings about 170px tall. Paving stones about 55-65px projected height, a person about two paving stones tall. Consistent object scale across the map; buildings several times adult height and many adult widths. NOT huge dollhouse doors.
LAYOUT: exactly three separated destination structures with clear long open routes between them: upper left modest two-story inn (roughly x350..1350,y180..850) cream plaster timber, terracotta roof, entrance at south/bottom facade, stacked barrels without a sign, small warm lit windows even in daylight, a couple outdoor tables close beside the inn NOT blocking the approach. Upper right solid guild archive (roughly x2600..3500,y180..850), gray masonry, slate roof, tall narrow windows, SOUTH-facing door and a red-wax-sealed blank parchment notice beside it. Lower center roofed wooden public notice stand (roughly x1700..2250,y1450..1750) facing south, with blank cream papers, two small market stalls to its sides with muted cream/terracotta awnings and crates. Broad open paved apron SOUTH of every entrance including the notice stand. Notice stand is smaller than a house.
WALKABILITY: large continuous light warm gray/beige flagstone plaza comprises at least 60 percent of map, linking all three locations. Small quiet irregular paving with low contrast seams; no big motifs, no text, no circles, no ornamental central emblem, no fountain. Darker grass/soil beds clearly contain buildings, props and shrubs, edged with low curbs, so occupied areas are visually distinct from light walkable stone. Central x1400..2500,y450..1400 remains generously empty for movement. Side paths broad and connected; never a narrow maze.
BOUNDARIES: enclose ALL FOUR edges with continuous low stone boundary walls / timber fence and small shrubs. Closed boundary, no gaps showing void, no exposed floating island, no canvas border. Bottom wall low enough not to hide walkable pavement. The roofs and destinations remain inside frame and uncut.
No people, animals, silhouettes, letters, numbers, labels, signage, readable writing, icons, symbols, watermark, grid overlay, pixel art, grain, photorealism, glossy materials, dramatic dark vignette. Blank papers truly blank. One polished continuous painted background.

revision.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this village map. Preserve the exact high oblique camera, map layout, light, colors, fine hand-drawn non-pixel style, warm light paving, boundary wall and vegetation, blank paper, three separated south-facing destinations, absence of people/text/sky.
ONE TARGETED CHANGE: all destination BUILDINGS and their associated props are currently too large for the intended 135px tall adult on a 3840x2160 map. Reduce the inn, guild and roofed notice stand INCLUDING all their tables, stools, barrels, stairs, stalls, plants and immediate soil islands to about 72% of their current linear size, centered at the same respective map locations. Fill the released area naturally with the same quiet stone paving and smoothly joined ground. Keep the inn upper left, guild upper right, notice board lower center, entrances all downward with uninterrupted paved approach aprons. Doors should be about 170px tall relative to the 3840x2160 canvas; stool height about 40px and table height about 65px. Keep boundary wall unchanged. Buildings fully contained inside frame. No drawn character or scale marks. Blank papers and red wax seal only. No text, letters, numbers, signage. Exact 3840x2160 16:9 opaque image.
